# Llamatik

> Llamatik is free, open-source AI that runs on your own device: chat, vision, voice, image and video generation, with no account and no ads. Apps for Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux and the browser (WebAssembly), plus a Kotlin Multiplatform SDK, a self-hosted server and an AI coding assistant for JetBrains IDEs.

Prompts, chats, documents and voice are processed locally. Diagnostics (Android only) are opt-in and off by default. The website uses no cookies and no analytics.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.llamatik.com/): overview, features and prompt box
- [Download](https://www.llamatik.com/download/): apps for every platform
- [Web app](https://www.llamatik.com/prompt/): run Llamatik in the browser
- [Llamatik Code](https://www.llamatik.com/llamatik-code/): coding assistant for IntelliJ IDEA and Android Studio
- [FAQ](https://www.llamatik.com/faq/): common questions
- [Blog](https://www.llamatik.com/blog/): release notes and guides
- [Privacy policy](https://www.llamatik.com/privacy/)
